revisions: Row-state mixture invalidates a strong natural-source-use claim without further controls.
Removed healthy dominant-route gate; source interaction can be defined without initial dominance.
Conflict inputs and agreement hybrid patches require separate estimands.
Accuracy-only code guard misses observed continuous-margin change.
participants.final_cross_review: Agreed with selector bottleneck first, conditional truth-versus-source backup second, intermediate reuse third. Added cue-only baseline and cue-excluded query patch; warned about lexical cue transport.

adopted_changes: Use intervention effects to localize attention and MLP sites before a bounded native-group search; do not call localization a novel paper claim.
Recipient a/b and both donor route answers c/d, and their code letters, must be distinguishable under generator constraints.
Constrained balanced randomization is not an unrestricted factorial; comparisons stay within allowed cells.
Primary transfer must follow recipient alternative computation, excluding both selected and unselected donor answer copying.
Query-G necessity, cross-world selector transfer and independently sourced selector-specific rescue are separate required tests. Same-forward original-value restoration is technical only.
Query-scoped G rescue explicitly replaces its mask and reopens G; R6-A is a new intervention protocol, not R5 continuing under an unchanged zero mask.
Continuous code-only margin, four-code distribution, local postnorm magnitude/direction and fixed random-panel checks replace accuracy-only specificity reasoning.
Add cue-only and full-residual reference interventions, cue-excluded query scope, fresh cue aliases and table-name assignments.
Discovery-only target/scope selection, independent calibration validation and full pre-confirmation arm registration; no old R5 split reuse.
Keep all proposed studies DRAFT/NOT_EVALUATED and novelty UNVERIFIED.
corrections_and_nonadopted_suggestions: Do not call row-position patch sensitivity natural source dependence: later row states can mix other sources and answers.
Do not infer absence of a localized source from a finite coarse grid missing an arbitrary 50% recovery threshold.
A healthy dominant source is unnecessary for a relative source-use interaction, though required for the stronger original dominant-route-switch narrative.
Valid symbolic conflict input does not prove training-distribution support.
Whole-residual patch is a comparison, not a guaranteed mathematical upper bound. Avoid an unstable recovery-ratio denominator.
Do not treat sham percentiles or exact identity replay error as the practical SESOI; noise floor and practical targets differ.
Expert 8–10k/16,220 budgets were incomplete provisional arm counts. Only a proposed bounded 2500-call pilot envelope is enumerated here; full confirmation is not ready.

GPT used an alternate Causal Registers title for 2606.29522; official title verified as When Does Activation Steering Change What a Model Computes From? DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0340088 was inaccessible and is not used as verified support.

literature_audit.title: Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability
literature_audit.overlap: Interchange interventions and many circuit methods are already formalized; method application alone is not a new contribution.

literature_audit.title: Function Vectors in Large Language Models
literature_audit.overlap: Compact causal task/function information transfers across contexts. A source selector is not novel merely because it transfers.

literature_audit.title: Competition of Mechanisms: Tracing How Language Models Handle Facts and Counterfactuals
literature_audit.overlap: Mechanism competition and attention-mediated strength control are already studied.

literature_audit.title: Rewired or Gated? How Instruction Tuning Shapes Knowledge-Conflict Circuits in LLMs
literature_audit.access: Official abstract read by Codex; GPT final explicitly could not access this page
literature_audit.overlap: Base-versus-instruct knowledge-conflict circuits, causal ablation/path patching and reweighting. R6 must show receiver-world computation with answer/label and independent-rescue controls; no first claim.

literature_audit.title: Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits
literature_audit.access: Abstract and sections 3.2/3.3, C.2.2 read by Codex; GPT final could not access v3
literature_audit.overlap: Conditional backup importance, matched severity and normalization replay, causal load-bearing freezing and knockout already exist. R6-B would test source-faithfulness versus authority-fixed correctness, not merely backup recovery.

literature_audit.title: The Hydra Effect
literature_audit.overlap: Immediate compensatory computation is established; not the novel claim.

literature_audit.title: Explorations of Self-Repair in Language Models
literature_audit.access: Official abstract read; normalization context reviewed earlier
literature_audit.overlap: Compensation and normalization-sensitive changes require care; replay is a modified-graph sensitivity analysis.

literature_audit.title: When Does Activation Steering Change What a Model Computes From?
literature_audit.access: Official current title and abstract verified
literature_audit.overlap: Edited register values used by later operations directly overlap R6-C. A held-out downstream-function test alone is insufficient as a new method.
literature_audit.correction: GPT initial used the alternate title Do Models Read What They Write? Causal Registers in Scratchpad Reasoning; use official title here.

literature_audit.title: Do Large Language Models Latently Perform Multi-Hop Reasoning?
literature_audit.overlap: Latent multi-hop utilization is contextual; route-use mapping alone is not new.

literature_audit.title: How Do LLMs Perform Two-Hop Reasoning in Context?
literature_audit.overlap: Synthetic two-hop reasoning and attention mechanisms studied, including trained small transformers. Does not establish the important site in our frozen Gemma.

literature_audit.title: Towards Automated Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
literature_audit.access: Official abstract and NeurIPS proceedings abstract read
literature_audit.overlap: Automated patching-based discovery is a tool, not R6 novelty.

literature_audit.title: Have Faith in Faithfulness: Going Beyond Circuit Overlap When Finding Model Mechanisms
literature_audit.overlap: EAP-IG circuit faithfulness already studied; component overlap is not enough.

literature_audit.title: Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching
literature_audit.overlap: Patching can activate alternate pathways, so output control alone is not faithful localization. Does not imply all patching is invalid.

literature_audit.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
literature_audit.overlap: Metric and corruption choice can alter localization; qualify corruption/control choices.
